Let \(H\) be the orthocenter of \(\triangle AGO\). Put the origin at \(A\), and write position vectors
\[
\mathbf b,\mathbf c,\mathbf o,\mathbf g,\mathbf h
\]
for \(B,C,O,G,H\). Then
\[
|\mathbf b|=11,\qquad |\mathbf c|=13,\qquad \mathbf g=\frac{\mathbf b+\mathbf c}{3}.
\]

Since \(O\) is the circumcenter of \(\triangle ABC\),
\[
\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf o=\frac{|\mathbf b|^2}{2}=\frac{121}{2},\qquad
\mathbf c\cdot\mathbf o=\frac{|\mathbf c|^2}{2}=\frac{169}{2}.
\]
Thus
\[
\mathbf g\cdot\mathbf o
=\frac{1}{3}(\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf o+\mathbf c\cdot\mathbf o)
=\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{121}{2}+\frac{169}{2}\right)
=\frac{145}{3}.
\]

Because \(H\) is the orthocenter of \(\triangle AGO\), with \(A=0\):

- Altitude from \(G\) perpendicular to \(AO\):
\[
(\mathbf h-\mathbf g)\cdot\mathbf o=0
\implies \mathbf h\cdot\mathbf o=\mathbf g\cdot\mathbf o=\frac{145}{3}.
\]

- Altitude from \(A\) perpendicular to \(GO\):
\[
\mathbf h\cdot(\mathbf o-\mathbf g)=0
\implies \mathbf h\cdot\mathbf o=\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf g.
\]
So also
\[
\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf g=\frac{145}{3}.
\]

Since \(H\) lies on line \(BC\), there is a real number \(\lambda\) such that
\[
\mathbf h=(1-\lambda)\mathbf b+\lambda\mathbf c.
\]
Using \(\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf o=\frac{145}{3}\):
\[
(1-\lambda)\frac{121}{2}+\lambda\frac{169}{2}=\frac{145}{3}.
\]
This gives
\[
121+48\lambda=\frac{290}{3}
\implies 48\lambda=-\frac{73}{3}
\implies \lambda=-\frac{73}{144}.
\]

Now use \(\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf g=\frac{145}{3}\):
\[
3\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf g
=\bigl((1-\lambda)\mathbf b+\lambda\mathbf c\bigr)\cdot(\mathbf b+\mathbf c).
\]
Expanding,
\[
3\mathbf h\cdot\mathbf g
=(1-\lambda)|\mathbf b|^2+\lambda|\mathbf c|^2+\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c.
\]
Therefore
\[
145=(1-\lambda)121+\lambda169+\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c
=121+48\lambda+\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c.
\]
Substitute \(\lambda=-\frac{73}{144}\):
\[
121+48\left(-\frac{73}{144}\right)
=121-\frac{73}{3}
=\frac{290}{3}.
\]
Hence
\[
\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c=145-\frac{290}{3}=\frac{145}{3}.
\]

Finally,
\[
BC^2=|\mathbf b-\mathbf c|^2
=|\mathbf b|^2+|\mathbf c|^2-2\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c
=121+169-2\left(\frac{145}{3}\right)
=\frac{580}{3}.
\]
Thus
\[
BC=\sqrt{\frac{580}{3}}=\frac{2\sqrt{435}}{3}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{2\sqrt{435}}{3}}
\]
